layers.inputs: x_k, map snapshot, full query, Start-Safe status
layers.pass: full-query admissible or post-repair full-query verified
layers.purpose: admit, repair, or explicitly fail-close a current/start state
layers.unresolved: map query validity and repair policy are external contracts

layers.inputs: x_k, map snapshot, frozen immediate position path
layers.purpose: primary execution-admission and late-risk detector for [t_k,t_(k+1)]
layers.unresolved: continuous segment/model consistency requires a frozen certificate contract

layers.control_authority: first affects position on [t_(k+1),t_(k+2)] and p_(k+2)
layers.inputs: x_k, u_k, map snapshot, horizon/witness assumptions
layers.purpose: conceptual future-safety predicate for candidate u_k
layers.unresolved: not implemented in formal Core V1; H2 requires an explicit future-control witness

layers.inputs: future-safe candidate, braking/terminal witness, terminal condition
layers.unresolved: witness absence is not mathematical unrecoverability

layers.inputs: admissible x_k, immediate-safe path, primary failure type, finite library
layers.purpose: finite alternative search after a candidate-dependent primary non-certification
layers.unresolved: finite library does not prove continuous-space infeasibility

layers.entry: terminal certified or no lawful certified route remains
layers.purpose: execute a terminal action only with certificate, otherwise explicitly fail-close
layers.unresolved: fail-close is not a guaranteed safe stop
